ML1 C6 Tracking Inspection:
Found that tracking was not the issue. There is no detection installed at this end to detect a Jam or if the belt is off, so the belt does not fault.
Issue: Chocolate Bars getting Jammed at the transition to the Cavanna small conveyor acting like a brake and causing the belt to shoot to one side. When the conveyor is Jammed it is staying in high speed due to eye alignment.

Root Cause: Guides were too low and tight with no leading edge into the small Cavanna belt.

Low speed EYE bracket was angled so it was not detecting Chocolate bars. The belt was staying at high speed when jammed and causing the jam to amplify quickly. Moved the bracket back to a 90° angle and now the orange output on the eye is working again.
